name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli
tagline: A tranquil haven of natural beauty and rich cultural heritage

topAttractions.name: Dadra Beach
topAttractions.description: A scenic beach along the Arabian Sea, perfect for relaxation and water sports

topAttractions.name: Silvassa Tribal Museum
topAttractions.description: A museum showcasing the history and culture of the local tribes, with a collection of artifacts and exhibits

topAttractions.name: Vanganga Lake
topAttractions.description: A serene lake surrounded by lush greenery, ideal for boating and picnics

bestTimeToVisit: October to March, when the weather is mild and pleasant
culturalFact: Dadra and Nagar Haveli is home to the Warli tribe, known for their unique Warli paintings, which are a UNESCO-recognized intangible cultural heritage of India

hiddenGem.name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli Wildlife Sanctuary
hiddenGem.description: A protected area with a diverse range of flora and fauna, including several species of birds and animals

relatedFestival: The Warli festival, celebrated by the local Warli tribe to mark the beginning of the harvest season
passportTieIn: If you have stamps or wishlist items for Gujarat or Maharashtra, you may be interested in visiting Dadra and Nagar Haveli, as it is a union territory located between these two states.
